verdict.rationale: Fenwick publishes a seed-financing explainer ('considerations and possible structures for seed financings') in its Startup Resource Center and runs a stated startup & venture capital practice representing 1,500+ VC-backed companies. That covers the 'published explainers' and 'stated early-stage financing practice' parts of the story, but nothing in the pack names SAFEs or convertible notes specifically. missing for 10: explicit SAFE/convertible-note content or forms, documented pre-seed-specific practice, independent corroboration of depth in convertible instruments.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice

citations.quote: Incorporation Stage Issues and Seed Financings Overview — Common issues startup founders face at incorporation, plus considerations and possible structures for seed financings.
